name: 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia
short_description: A half-marathon and 10km race held in Putrajaya, Malaysia on November 1, 2026, organized by Garmin Malaysia; registration is sold out.
ai_summary: The 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia is a half-marathon event scheduled for November 1, 2026, in Putrajaya, Malaysia. Organized by Garmin Malaysia with SCORE Experience as technical partner, the race offers 21.1km and 10km distance options starting near Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya. Registration for this edition is currently sold out, indicating strong demand from runners.

faqs.question: When is the 2026 Garmin Run Marathon Series – Malaysia taking place?
faqs.answer: This race is scheduled to take place on November 1, 2026. It will be held in Putrajaya, Malaysia, starting in front of Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya, and is organized by Garmin Malaysia together with technical partner SCORE Experience for participants across the region.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event features two distance categories: a 21.1km half-marathon, which serves as the primary distance, and a shorter 10km race. Both distances start from the same venue in front of Mahkamah Syariah WP Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia, giving runners flexibility depending on their fitness and goals.
